description: Convert ApiExplorerPanel.js from light two-panel split layout to Mock B dark IDE three-column layout.
steps: Read PingOneMcpInspector.js as the reference for Mock B layout structure.

Rewrite ApiExplorerPanel.js to use p1mcp-* CSS classes for Mock B three-column layout: (1) Top bar with status dot (green when live polling, grey when paused), title 'API Explorer', status showing call count and live/paused state, Pause/Live button and Clear button in top-right; (2) Column 1 (tree): the call list -- each API call shown as a tree item with method badge (color-coded GET=blue, POST=green, DELETE=red, etc.), URL truncated, status code, and duration; the stats row (Total/Success/Errors/Avg) shown as a tree header or footer; active/selected call highlighted in blue; (3) Column 2 (form): since this is a viewer not a command issuer, column 2 shows the selected call's metadata -- full URL, method, status code, duration -- formatted like a 'tool' description area, plus any request body displayed in editable-looking (but readonly) fields; (4) Column 3 (output): tabbed output with 'Response Body', 'Request Body', 'Headers' tabs (same as existing detail panel tabs), JsonHighlight-rendered content, footer with status code and duration.
Preserve all existing functionality: polling via fetch('/api/api-calls?limit=100'), live/pause toggle, clear function, call selection, detail inspection.
Import PingOneMcpInspector.css. Replace ApiExplorerPanel.css light-themed styles with dark p1mcp-* classes.
Keep the existing fetch-based API calls (not apiClient -- this component uses raw fetch).
acceptance_criteria: ApiExplorerPanel.js renders a dark IDE three-column layout with p1mcp-* CSS classes
Column 1 shows API call history as tree items with method badges and status dots
Column 2 shows selected call metadata (URL, method, status, duration)
Column 3 shows tabbed output (Response Body, Request Body, Headers) with syntax highlighting
Top bar shows live/paused status and call count
Live polling and clear functionality preserved
verification: cd demo_api_ui && HTTPS=false npx vite build
findings: Conversion successful. Replaced light two-panel split layout with p1mcp-* three-column dark IDE grid. Top bar shows live/paused status dot (green=live, grey=paused), title 'API Explorer', call count with live/paused label, Pause/Live and Clear buttons. Column 1 (tree) shows API calls as tree items with color-coded method badges (GET=blue, POST=green, DELETE=red, PUT=amber), truncated URL, status code badge, duration, and green/red dot for success/error. Search filter and stats footer included. Column 2 (form) shows selected call metadata in readonly fields: URL, method, status code, duration, request body textarea. Column 3 (output) has three tabs: Response Body, Request Body, Headers, each with JsonHighlight syntax highlighting and a footer showing status/duration/transport. Imports PingOneMcpInspector.css for base p1mcp-* styles; ApiExplorerPanel.css reduced to dark-themed component-specific overrides (aep-* prefix for tree items, method badges, stats footer). All API calls preserved using raw fetch (not apiClient). Build passes cleanly.
